fps.title: FPS Game Prototype
fps.description: An FPS prototype built in Unity featuring a custom player controller, enemy AI with patrol/chase/attack states, and core shooting mechanics. Focused on snappy game-feel, modular AI behaviour, and lean architecture for future expansion.

drone.title: VR Drone Controller
drone.description: Immersive VR-based drone control system with real-time first-person navigation and live camera feed. Built with custom OpenXR input handlers and a hybrid teleport/smooth locomotion model for comfort.

space.title: Spacecraft 3D Models
space.description: A curated set of high-quality spacecraft models authored in Blender — topology optimised for real-time engines, PBR-textured, and ready to drop into Unity or Unreal space-themed projects.

flood.title: VR Flood Simulation
flood.description: A real-location, photogrammetry-driven flood simulation in VR. Real terrain captured with Polycam, refined in Blender, and integrated into Unity with HDRP water — optimised to 90–110 FPS while ingesting live flow parameters.
